anomalies: No hourly forecast CSV survives: metrics.csv contains six model-summary rows. Forecast caches were deleted, so the headline MAPE cannot be recomputed from the delivered CSV.

The seven pre-selection test-scored forecasts comprise six final model forecasts plus a two-epoch N-BEATS smoke forecast. After the initial winner selection, five LightGBM quantile curves were additionally test-scored diagnostically (session.jsonl:815-816); q0.1 scored 2.897%, but the regression point forecast remained the headline.
PatchTST was unavailable; TSMixer was used and disclosed, although metrics.json labels its entry 'patchtst'. No PatchTST fit was attempted.

Failures included a blocked sleep command, a Prophet module-name collision, a wrong-relative-path check, and 10-minute and 7-minute timeouts. An unavailable 'timeout' executable also appeared in an otherwise unflagged shell result.
N-BEATS and TSMixer subprocesses initially segfaulted with exit 139 inside a wrapper that returned exit 0. Lazy imports and isolated model processes subsequently allowed successful forecasts.
The agent wrote temporary scripts, logs and a forecast pickle under /tmp, outside its working directory. output_outside also contains a .ruff_cache directory.
The final message reports 29.5 minutes runtime, while delivered metrics.json reports 1833.13 seconds and transcript.md reports 30.6 minutes.
The final claim that test data never entered selection is too broad: hyperparameters used pre-test validation, but the winning model was explicitly selected by test MAPE.
one_line_summary: Compared six model classes with pre-test hyperparameter validation, selected LightGBM by test MAPE (4.9943%), and delivered code, methods and interval plots, but no hourly forecast CSV.
